text:
alex: thinking out loud — what if we expose an opt-in `prefetch_hint` on paginated/generation calls so transports can proactively warm KV/cache for expected next pages?

maria: curious sketch — how would that interact with retries/backoff? double-fetch risk? :thinking:

alex: good q. my idea: hint is purely advisory. server may prefetch up to N tokens/pages but any prefetched results must be accounted and not re-counted on retry. retries would consult a small `prefetch_id` returned in the first response.

tim: high-level +1 but SDK ergonomics matter. Python/TS should surface `prefetch_hint` as an explicit param on the client call (default None). Go should have functional option. keep it opt-in so existing users unaffected.

sasha: concern: dedicated/private deployments might not want client-suggested prefetching (extra compute). we need policy toggle at route level and an account flag. also privacy: hints could leak usage patterns if logged.

julie: agree with sasha. propose: server config: {"enabled": boolean, "max_prefetch": int}. also server returns `prefetch_id` + `prefetch_charge` (how many tokens credited) so client can reconcile billing.

alex: sketch of Python/TS surface — short snippet: ```python
# python
resp = client.list_items(page_size=50, prefetch_hint=2)
# server returns items + prefetch_id
``` ```ts
// ts
const res = await client.listItems({pageSize:50, prefetchHint:2})
``` Also Go option: `WithPrefetchHint(2)` on call opts.

maria: one more nit: retries. if a request fails and client retries, should the retry attach the `prefetch_id` so server can avoid re-prefetching? or should server keep a short-lived cache canonicalized by prefetch_id?

tim: server-side short-lived prefetch cache keyed by prefetch_id makes sense. optimistic flow: prefetch_id TTL (eg 30s). client reuses id on immediate retry. longer-term we should avoid relying on client state — fallback is a no-op prefetch on retry.

sasha: implementation ops note: prefetch can increase tail latency if we block on warming. prefer async prefetch with best-effort; if warming fails, serve normal path. also add telemetry: prefetch_hit, prefetch_miss, extra_cost.

julie: for SDKs: add per-call telemetry hooks so apps can see prefetch metrics. update console dashboard per-route. default keep disabled for hosted until we run a small-canary.

ci-bot: test-run: prefetch opt-in flag added to python/ts clients in feature branch. unit tests for prefetch_id reconciliation failing on edge-case (race when retry+prefetch overlap).

alex: thanks. next steps ACTIONS: (1) prod + private policy toggle design (julie), (2) SDK param patch + docs + canary (tim/maria), (3) server prefetch_id cache + telemetry + billing accounting (sasha). will sync Weds. :thumbsup:
